states.notes: The Brandenburg lane now carries its first reviewed lower-secondary functions corridor, its first reviewed upper-secondary E-phase analysis entry corridor, its first reviewed Q1 model-functions follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 integral-calculus follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 stochastics follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 data-and-distribution follow-on corridor, and its first reviewed Q2 survey-and-critique follow-on corridor on the canonical spine. Active mapped surface reaches J7-J10, the shared E/F functions corridor, the Brandenburg E-phase derivative starter strip, the Q1 model-functions strip around exponential, logarithmic, and periodic functions, the Q2 integral strip around upper and lower sums, reconstructed stock, the Fundamental Theorem, antiderivatives, and first area and context applications, the Q2 stochastics strip around tree diagrams, contingency tables, conditional probabilities, stochastic independence, urn models, and simulations, the Q2 data-and-distribution strip around sample characteristics, random variables, discrete distributions, histograms, and first binomial situations, the Q2 survey-and-critique strip around statistical survey planning, data preparation, and critical evaluation with descriptive measures, and the structural upper-secondary phase bridge E/Q1-Q4.
states.nextStep: Widen the Brandenburg lower-secondary lane beyond the first functions corridor while the shared BE/BB overlap stays tight.

states.notes: The Berlin lane now carries its first reviewed lower-secondary functions corridor, its first reviewed upper-secondary Q1 differential entry corridor, its first reviewed Q2 integral-calculus follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 stochastics follow-on corridor, its first reviewed Q2 data-and-survey follow-on corridor, and its first reviewed Q4 distribution-and-binomial follow-on corridor on the canonical spine. Active mapped surface reaches J7-J10, the shared E/F functions corridor, the Berlin Q1 differential starter strip, the Q2 integral strip around reconstructed stock, the Fundamental Theorem, antiderivatives, and first area applications, the Q2 stochastics strip around tree diagrams, contingency tables, conditional probabilities, stochastic independence, urn models, and simulations, the Q2 data-and-survey strip around statistical surveys, data preparation, sample location and dispersion measures, and survey evaluation with descriptive measures, the Q4 distribution-and-binomial strip around binomial models with parameters n and p, Bernoulli chains, binomial probabilities, expected value, standard deviation, and first context use, and the structural upper-secondary phase bridge E/Q1-Q4.
states.nextStep: Widen the Berlin upper-secondary lane from the active Q4 distribution-and-binomial corridor toward the first Q4 inference, tests, and normal-approximation follow-on corridor.
